$comment: v0.2 sibling of del-004 (which stays frozen in the v0.1 wire shape for v0.1 runners). Structural-rejection fixture: the chain entries are __ANY_JWS__ and chain_hash is __ANY_CHAIN_HASH__ because a core (non-opted-in) implementation MUST reject on the mere presence of the `chain` claim before any per-hop processing — those values are never inspected (see PLACEHOLDERS.md, ignored-value placeholders).
description: A v0.2 delegation token (compact JWS, typ aitp-delegation+jwt) whose decoded claims carry a `chain` claim MUST be rejected by a core (non-opted-in) implementation with DELEGATION_MULTIHOP_NOT_SUPPORTED, regardless of any other validity property of the token. The `chain` claim is the RFC-AITP-0011 opt-in marker; RFC-AITP-0006 §4 (multi-hop guard) requires the structural rejection before any per-hop signature, scope, or chain-hash work. Per the chain-bearing token shape the outer claims carry jti and chain_hash and NO voucher (only chain[0] would carry the voucher — RFC-AITP-0011 §1.1), but none of that is processed: presence of `chain` alone triggers the rejection. Multi-hop acceptance semantics are exercised by the `del-mh-*` opt-in fixture set.

expected.rationale: The decoded claims carry a `chain` claim and the implementation under test has not opted into RFC-AITP-0011. The rejection is structural/early: no chain-entry signature, continuity, scope, or chain_hash verification is performed, which is why the chain entry and chain_hash are ignored-value placeholders.
